[[Mallyx's Courage]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] obtained from the [[Citadel Chest]], which spawns after defeating [[Mallyx the Unyielding]] in [[The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Strength]])
:Received [[physical damage]] -5 (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the [[skin]] of an [[Iridescent Aegis]] [[dye]]d white.

*[[Bronze Shield]] from crafters [[Manzo]], [[Honglei Sun]], [[Theodosus]], [[Gertrud]], [[Mathilde]], or [[Telamon]]
*[[Shield of the Lion]] from crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]], or [[Kol Swordshanks]] or collector [[Kwesi]]
*[[Wooden Buckler]] from collector [[Maddison]]
